import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import io

# Load the dataset from the string
csv_data = """survived,pclass,sex,age,sibsp,parch,fare,embarked,class,who,adult_male,deck,embark_town,alive,alone
0,3,male,22.0,1,0,7.25,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,False
1,1,female,38.0,1,0,71.2833,C,First,woman,False,C,Cherbourg,yes,False
1,3,female,26.0,0,0,7.925,S,Third,woman,False,,Southampton,yes,True
1,1,female,35.0,1,0,53.1,S,First,woman,False,C,Southampton,yes,False
0,3,male,35.0,0,0,8.05,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,True
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# --- Visualization ---

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and a set of subplots
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(12, 10), sharex=True)

# Define a color palette
palette = {"male": "#0077b6", "female": "#d62728"}

# --- Top Plot: Passenger Count ---
sns.countplot(
    data=df,
    x='class',
    hue='sex',
    ax=ax1,
    palette=palette,
    order=['First', 'Second', 'Third']
)
ax1.set_title('Passenger Count by Class and Sex', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('')
ax1.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=12)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', which='both', bottom=False) # Hide x-ticks for top plot

# Add annotations for counts
for p in ax1.patches:
    ax1.annotate(f'{int(p.get_height())}',
                 (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., p.get_height()),
                 ha='center', va='center',
                 fontsize=11,
                 xytext=(0, 5),
                 textcoords='offset points')

# --- Bottom Plot: Survival Rate ---
sns.barplot(
    data=df,
    x='class',
    y='survived',
    hue='sex',
    ax=ax2,
    palette=palette,
    order=['First', 'Second', 'Third'],
    errorbar=None
)
ax2.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Sex', fontsize=16, weight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=14)
ax2.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylim(0, 1.1)

# Format y-axis as percentage
ax2.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.PercentFormatter(xmax=1.0))

# Add annotations for survival rates
for p in ax2.patches:
    if p.get_height() > 0:
        ax2.annotate(f'{p.get_height():.0%}',
                     (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., p.get_height()),
                     ha='center', va='center',
                     fontsize=11,
                     xytext=(0, 9),
                     textcoords='offset points')

# --- Final Touches ---

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Titanic Survival Analysis (Based on Sample Data)', fontsize=20, weight='bold', y=0.98)

# Improve legend
handles, labels = ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
fig.legend(handles, labels, loc='upper right', bbox_to_anchor=(0.95, 0.92), title='Sex')
ax1.get_legend().remove()
ax2.get_legend().remove()

# Adjust layout to prevent overlap
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.95])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
